principles.executive_independence: Executives do not reach into one another's data; each owns its own data, integrations, analysis, recommendations, and actions.
principles.human_control: AI advises, and never acts autonomously on high-risk decisions — financial transfers, irreversible changes, and anything with real-world consequence always require explicit human approval.
